title: 火灾系统不可控
description: 火灾随机发生且迅速蔓延，电路故障引发火灾无法预防。
evidence:
Random fire no reason just fire
Instantly takes over half the ship

a circuit on the brink of collapse in the brand new section of the ship me and victoria blessing had built with our blood sweat and tears sparked and caused a fire instantly filling the cabin with smoke
